description: This Java class 'PersistentConfiguration' manages loading and saving application configuration data using XML encoding/decoding. It implements singleton pattern to provide a single instance and handles configuration stored as a map, with methods to load from and save to an XML file.

classes.name: PersistentConfiguration
classes.description: Singleton class managing application configuration stored in an XML file with load and save capabilities.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PersistentConfiguration.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads configuration data from an XML file and deserializes it into a map.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes current configuration data into an XML file.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns a new Node object initialized with the root label and current configuration map.
